summary: Frontend E2E testing of Super Admin → Demo Accounts fixes (create with empty modules, seed toast, case-insensitive dup validation, delete with name confirmation). All 4 reported bugs verified as FIXED. No regressions.

test_results.create_empty_modules: PASS — POST /api/super-admin/demo-accounts returns 200 with modules_to_activate=[]. No more NameError 500. Account created with 0 modules and trial through 8/5/2027.
test_results.seed_toast_events: PASS — Toast shows: 'Demo data seeded: 5 clients · 12 ingredients · 6 recipes · 1 menus · 3 events · 3 proposals' (matches expected seed_counts for industry=events).
test_results.duplicate_email_case_insensitive: PASS — Creating with 'TEST_EVENTS_1785937760@TEST.COM' (uppercase of existing) blocked with red toast: "Email 'TEST_EVENTS_1785937760@test.com' is already registered". Backend returns 400.
test_results.duplicate_org_case_insensitive: PASS — Creating with lowercase 'test_events_1785937760' (existing is 'TEST_Events_1785937760') blocked with toast: "Organization 'test_events_1785937760' already exists. Use a different name or edit the existing organization." Backend returns 400.
test_results.dropdown_delete_option: PASS — Dropdown shows 'Delete Account' in red at bottom (after Copy email, Edit Account, Convert to Paid, Extend Trial). data-testid='demo-account-delete-btn-{company_id}' present.
test_results.delete_modal_confirmation: PASS — Modal (data-testid='demo-account-delete-modal') opens. Confirm button (data-testid='demo-account-delete-confirm-btn') disabled by default and with wrong name; enabled only when input matches organization_name exactly (case sensitive as expected).
test_results.delete_execution_and_toast: PASS — Confirm delete removed account from list. Toast shows deletion counts: '1 users · 1 subscriptions · 1 organization_configs · 3 events · 5 leads · 3 proposals · 12 ingredients · 6 recipes · 1 menus · 1 companies' + "Account 'TEST_Events_1785937760' deleted". Total Accounts counter went 4→3.

critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 401 errors on /api/... during login page load — appears to be auth-check calls before token is set. Cosmetic only, non-blocking; consider guarding these calls when no token present.
The delete name-confirmation is case-sensitive while duplicate detection is case-insensitive. This is acceptable UX (delete should be strict) but worth noting for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Events_1785937760 demo account then deleted it during the delete test. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 originally reported bugs on Super Admin Demo Accounts are fixed and verified E2E via UI. Terminology bonus (agency=Proyecto) was not tested per request note. Backend was validated via curl by main agent previously.
